checkpoint_27.mission: Prove a cold reader can reproduce headline results without undocumented knowledge.

document_audit.cold_block:
export FAULTLINE_REPOSITORY_URL="${FAULTLINE_REPOSITORY_URL:-https://github.com/samirsawarkar/faultline-ai-reliability.git}"
git clone --config advice.detachedHead=false --branch v0.27.0-rc1 --depth 1 "$FAULTLINE_REPOSITORY_URL" faultline-ai-reliability
cd faultline-ai-reliability
make cold-reproduce

entries.ambiguity: A reader could not know which revision was evidence-bearing.
entries.resolution: Pin the clone command to v0.27.0-rc1 and explicitly forbid switching to main when the tag is unavailable.
entries.verification: The document audit requires the exact --branch revision and the cold clone checks out that tag.

entries.ambiguity: The host-Python route depended on whichever python3 happened to be installed.
entries.resolution: Use Docker as the sole cold path; no host Python, venv, or package installation appears in the executable block.
entries.verification: The document audit rejects pip, venv, and host-Python bootstrap commands.

entries.ambiguity: Having the Docker client did not prove that its daemon was reachable.
entries.resolution: Require docker version before cloning and repeat the daemon preflight inside make cold-reproduce.
entries.verification: The final transcript records docker preflight: PASS before image construction.

entries.ambiguity: The original one-command result said green without printing the reproduced headline numbers.
entries.resolution: Print all six registered README result strings and require an exact expected terminal block.
entries.verification: The cold-start report checks every expected line and the transcript contains all six.

entries.ambiguity: Required compute, memory, storage, network, and supported host boundaries were unstated.
entries.resolution: Document the tested architectures, minimum 2 CPU/4 GiB/5 GiB envelope, registry access, and WSL2 boundary.
entries.verification: The document audit treats every requirement token as mandatory.

entries.ambiguity: A mirror or local cold test would otherwise require silently editing the public clone URL.
entries.resolution: Define FAULTLINE_REPOSITORY_URL in the copied block with the public URL as its default.
entries.verification: The cold simulation uses the documented override and executes the block byte-for-byte.

entries.ambiguity: A partial clone could tempt a reader to repair state differently from another reader.
entries.resolution: Require an empty parent directory and instruct readers to restart in a new one after clone or build-state failures.
entries.verification: The harness creates a new temporary directory and confirms a fresh .git checkout.

entries.ambiguity: Failure recovery invited unpinned image or package substitutions.
entries.resolution: Provide symptom-specific stop/retry actions and explicitly prohibit changing evidence or dependency pins.
entries.verification: The troubleshooting audit requires tag, daemon, storage, registry, number-drift, and destination cases.

entries.ambiguity: Detached-HEAD advice and container layer IDs obscured the stable result lines in the transcript.
entries.resolution: Disable detached-HEAD advice and capture clean-build diagnostics unless the build fails.
entries.verification: The final successful transcript contains stable clone, preflight, build, headline, and exit lines only.

entries.ambiguity: A maintainer snapshot test assumed Git existed inside the deliberately Git-free runtime image.
entries.resolution: Keep the real snapshot/clone integration in the outer cold harness and unit-test only its NUL-safe file-list boundary inside the image.
entries.verification: The outer transcript proves the fresh tagged clone; the clean image needs no undocumented Git installation.

entries.ambiguity: Registered Make targets defaulted to a host .venv that is intentionally absent inside the clean image.
entries.resolution: Bind every internal headline-generator Make invocation to sys.executable, the Python interpreter supplied by the pinned image.
entries.verification: The reader still runs only make cold-reproduce; the final clean transcript regenerates all five research families without a host environment.

entries.ambiguity: A shallow clone of the annotated local release tag emitted a misleading warning that the tag object was not a commit.
entries.resolution: Use a direct commit tag for the unambiguous shallow-clone reproduction identity.
entries.verification: The final exact-tag clone resolves v0.27.0-rc1 without warning and retains the same commit identity.

execution.blocker: Platform approval for repository-controlled host Docker access was denied before clone/build execution.
